symptom: The deny-only synthetic reference helper previously read a caller-controlled reference fixture only after Ed25519 signature math and claimed-anchor correlation. A descriptor-triggered mutation during those earlier phases could change an initially mismatching reference key digest or anchor identity into a matching value before the late snapshot, causing referenceCorrelationConsistent=true for a different entry-time reference. No external authority or scoring was granted.
lesson: Even a non-authoritative metadata correlation flag can be laundered if its caller-owned reference fixture is first snapshotted only after unrelated validation phases. A matching post-mutation reference is not the reference supplied at entry.
guardrail: Pin the full strict own-data-descriptor synthetic reference fixture before signature math or policy comparison. Reuse only that detached snapshot for role, authority, anchor, key, state and validity-window checks. Regression tests must actually fire late key and identity mutations and show the original mismatches remain rejected, with literal independentAuthorityVerified=false and scoringAuthorized=false.
